title: Block Billing Actions for Containers on Hold

likelyFiles.reason: This file contains the PUT /api/bookings/:id endpoint, the checkCutoff function that needs extension, and is where the new isOnHold helper should be introduced. It directly controls server-side billing action blocking.
The frontend BookingFormPage is required to display a hold-lock message similar to the existing cutoff-lock behavior when a booking is in HOLD status, particularly impacting payor fields.
The booking detail page in the frontend must show a 'Billing blocked — container on hold' notice, requiring UI logic to detect and display this message.

evidence: Both tickets directly affect the `checkCutoff` function and the `LIFECYCLE` array.
Ticket CG-102 modifies these entities in `server/src/routes/bookings.ts`, while Ticket CG-105 moves these same entities out of `server/src/routes/bookings.ts`.
Both tickets require modifications to the same file, server/src/routes/bookings.ts, to implement status-related business logic.

Both tickets involve significant modifications to `server/src/routes/bookings.ts`; CG-101 adds the HOLD status and related logic, while CG-102 extends the `checkCutoff` function within this file to include HOLD status.
Both tickets require updates to `client/src/pages/BookingDetailPage.tsx`; CG-101 to display the HOLD status and potential actions, and CG-102 to show a 'Billing blocked' notice.
